glosses: prefecture (the district governed by a prefect)
prefecture (the office or position of a prefect)
town hall (a building that houses the local government offices of a town)

examples.text: A prefeitura não fica longe daqui.
examples.en: The city hall isn't far from here.

examples.text: Não vou me candidatar à prefeitura.
examples.en: I won't be running for mayor.
